title: Atomic Chat llama.cpp Backends Manifest
description: Schema for the remote llama.cpp backends manifest consumed by the Atomic Chat client (llamacpp-upstream extension). Mirrors the shape of a GitHub release JSON ({ tag_name, assets: [{ name }] }) so the client's existing asset-name parser is reused verbatim.

updated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; refresh on every meaningful change.

tag_name.description: ggml-org/llama.cpp release tag the assets belong to (e.g. b9691).

download_base.description: Base URL the client prepends to '<tag_name>/<asset name>' when downloading. Normally this repository's own release stream, whose archives carry Atomic Chat's Windows Authenticode and macOS Developer ID signatures. Omit it to fall back to the upstream ggml-org CDN, which is what a tag that has not been mirrored yet must do. Written by .github/workflows/mirror-upstream.yml.

assets.description: Release assets, mirroring GitHub's release JSON. Windows, Linux and Apple Silicon backend archives (plus the Windows cudart companions) are listed; the client filters them by host platform and architecture. macos-x64 is intentionally omitted - runtime engine updates on macOS are arm64 only.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the mirrored archive, verified by the client after download. Present only on assets this repository actually hosts; the cudart companions stay on the upstream CDN and carry no hash.

size.description: Archive size in bytes, checked before the hash so a truncated download fails fast.
